classification: The Web authority already preserves thread-scoped Composer drafts. Native previously discarded text when its keyed Composer unmounted and did not hydrate the host textarea from restored state. The current implementation moves text ownership into a thread-scoped client projection and keeps the Lynx textarea as a capability leaf. Exact-bundle Native leaves the draft for the same persisted canonical thread, returns to the same draft ID, restores send semantics with no placeholder, advances main transport, reports zero renderer errors, and disposes isolated state. This closes only route-scoped text restoration; PF2 remains in progress.
